proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12803.3 *kṣaṭ explicitly contains Punjabi che, Nepali cha, Oriya cha and Hindi/Gujarati cha; the addendum gives Jaunsari chau. These affricate six forms select section 3, not the ṣaṣ or *ṣuvaṭ branches. Exact survey form cə is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
